machine: Peach AMD Ryzen 9 7950X; CPU15; requested 4.5 GHz; boost disabled
build: Rust 1.94.1; target-cpu=native; release LTO; codegen-units=1; standalone locked dependencies
method: Median of six measured repetitions per binary across two processes, each with one excluded warmup; process order baseline/optimized/optimized/baseline; serial shared benchmark lock
scope: Measured complete CPU commitment, sequential encoding and hashing; setup, input generation, initial allocation and final destruction excluded. Only the 128-symbol x86 XOR expander was changed; opening estimates are unchanged.
validation: All 16 baseline/optimized commitments at each input size have identical roots. Scalar-reference tests pass in native and baseline x86-64 builds; twelve native expander/Brakedown tests pass.
